description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a copy of Spawning Pit that is a 4/4 artifact creature named Mishra's Warform.
Activate Mishra's Warform using Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing another creature, putting two charge counters on it.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 2.
